root_cause.text: The record-chain walk loops in bios_parser.c and bios_parser2.c lack an upper iteration bound, relying solely on a sentinel value (0xFF record_type) to terminate, so a malformed VBIOS image without the sentinel causes unbounded looping and potential out-of-bounds reads.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "All record-chain walk loops in bios_parser.c and bios_parser2.c use for(;;) and only terminate on a 0xFF record_type sentinel or zero record_size. A malformed VBIOS image missing the terminator record causes unbounded iteration at probe time... In the final iterations near the BIOS image boundary, struct casts beyond the 2-byte header validated by GET_IMAGE can also read out of bounds." The patch caps all 14 loops to BIOS_MAX_NUM_RECORD (256) iterations, adding a loop counter variable and limiting the for-loop to that bound.
